scripts.backend:setup: cd backend && npx prisma db push
scripts.redis:check: cd backend && node -r dotenv/config -e "const Redis=require('ioredis'); const redis=new Redis({host:process.env.REDIS_HOST||'127.0.0.1',port:Number(process.env.REDIS_PORT||6379),lazyConnect:true}); redis.connect().then(()=>redis.ping()).then(result=>{if(result!=='PONG') throw new Error('Redis did not return PONG'); console.log('Redis connected'); return redis.quit()}).catch(error=>{console.error('Redis connection failed:',error.message); process.exit(1)})"
scripts.setup: npm run backend:install && npm run backend:setup && npm run frontend:install && npm run redis:check
